covered_report_window.plain_language: U.S.-listed companies reporting after the Thursday, August 13, 2026 close and before the Friday, August 14, 2026 open

market_context_summary: July PPI was flat month over month and core PPI rose 0.2%, both slightly cooler than expected. Friday retail sales and preliminary consumer sentiment remain important overnight macro risks. AI and semiconductor positioning is constructive but crowded.

top_setups.note: Neutral names are not presented as directional setups.

consensus_method.disparity_definition: A 0-100 summary of the spread in direction and reversal-risk outputs across Pass A, Pass B, and Pass C; lower is tighter agreement.

ranked_companies.timing: 2026-08-13 after market close; 4:30 p.m. ET call
ranked_companies.expected_driver: Fiscal Q4 revenue and margin guidance
ranked_companies.key_risk_to_call: Beat priced in at a premium valuation
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: AI-driven DRAM, leading-edge logic and advanced-packaging demand favors an upside print, but the stock needs a strong October-quarter outlook to overcome a demanding valuation.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus is about $3.39-$3.45 adjusted EPS on roughly $9.0-$9.2 billion revenue versus company guidance of $3.36 plus or minus $0.20 and $8.95 billion plus or minus $0.50 billion.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Revenue clears $9 billion with resilient gross margin and fiscal Q4 growth above current expectations as Singapore output and AI equipment demand ramp.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: A merely in-line quarter, softer gross margin, export restrictions, or cautious fiscal Q4 commentary triggers multiple compression.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Available public options references imply a low-to-mid single-digit event move; the stock's strong AI-linked run and roughly 52x trailing P/E increase sell-the-news risk.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Stifel reiterated Buy and argued fiscal Q4 estimates could be conservative; Goldman and Citi recently highlighted upside catalysts, raising the whisper bar.

ranked_companies.expected_driver: Risk-adjusted NIM and cost of risk
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Record risk-adjusted NIM, low first-quarter cost of risk and reaffirmed 2026 guidance give Credicorp the cleanest risk-adjusted upside setup in the window.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Public estimates cluster around $7.20 per share and $1.72 billion revenue, though cross-provider currency and share-unit conversions are inconsistent.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Risk-adjusted NIM stays above the 5.3%-5.6% annual guide and cost of risk remains below the 1.7%-2.1% range while loan growth holds near target.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Funding-cost benefits fade, provisioning normalizes sharply higher, or Peru macro and political risk weaken forward ROE confidence.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Options evidence is limited; liquidity is adequate but much lower than AMAT or NU, so the reaction may be less efficient.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Evidence is constructive but sparse; two consecutive estimate misses reported by one data provider temper confidence despite strong operating metrics.

ranked_companies.timing: 2026-08-13 after market close; 5:00 p.m. ET call
ranked_companies.expected_driver: Gross profit growth and gross profit/TPV
ranked_companies.key_risk_to_call: TPV growth fails to convert into take-rate quality
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: High TPV growth can support upside only if gross profit and operating leverage confirm improving transaction economics.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Calendar consensus is $0.18 EPS; management retained 2026 guidance for 50%-60% TPV growth, 22.5%-27.5% gross-profit growth and 27.5%-32.5% operating-profit growth.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Broad-based TPV strength and normalized costs support the upper half of full-year operating-profit guidance.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Weak take rate, FX/mix pressure or working-capital noise undermines the volume headline.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: No dependable live implied move or short-interest figure was available; social discussion is constructive but sparse.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Current revision evidence was insufficient; retained company guidance is the more reliable bar.

ranked_companies.expected_driver: Organic revenue growth and forward guide
ranked_companies.key_risk_to_call: Low bar plus AI bookings relief
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: The market needs proof that AI positioning is converting into durable organic growth, leaving downside if the next-quarter guide stays soft.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Calendar consensus is $1.50 EPS; Q1 revenue was $607.1 million and management said Q2 guidance returned to growth.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: AI Pods, subscription initiatives and resilient margins produce a less-bad-than-feared guide.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Discretionary IT demand remains weak and forward revenue growth disappoints.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Reliable live implied-move and short-interest data were unavailable; social evidence was too thin to score materially.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Current pre-report revision evidence was insufficient; guidance quality dominates.

ranked_companies.key_risk_to_call: Low bar and cost-driven EBITDA relief
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: The promised second-half enrollment improvement faces a credibility test after weak core enrollment and a sharp Q1 adjusted-EBITDA decline.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Calendar consensus is $0.10 EPS; Q1 adjusted EBITDA fell 37.7% to $52.1 million even as management updated full-year guidance.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Enrollment inflects, Champions/B2B remains resilient and cost actions protect EBITDA.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Core occupancy stays weak and center-level operating leverage disappoints.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: No reliable live options or short-interest evidence was available; anecdotal consumer sentiment was not used directionally.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Current revision evidence was unavailable; management's promised enrollment detail is the decisive bar.

ranked_companies.timing: 2026-08-13 after market close; 5:00 p.m. ET call
ranked_companies.expected_driver: Cost of risk and 90+ day NPLs
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Rising 90-plus-day NPLs, a 21.9% cost of risk and compressed gross margin leave Stone vulnerable unless credit quality improves faster than expected.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus is roughly $0.46-$0.47 EPS and $706-$731 million revenue, with full-year expectations near $2.27 EPS and $2.91 billion revenue.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: NPLs stabilize, cost of risk moves toward the mid-to-high teens, ARPAC recovers and management preserves the second-half guidance path.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Credit provisions remain elevated, active-client monetization stays weak and management cuts or narrows the 2026 outlook.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Short interest was reported near 7% of float with about 3.8 days to cover, creating meaningful squeeze risk on a less-bad print.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Full-year consensus still embeds strong EPS growth, but Q1 margin and credit deterioration have made the second-half recovery bar more fragile.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Customer growth, rising ARPAC and Mexico break-even support upside, but the reaction hinges on whether risk-adjusted NIM recovers as early delinquencies normalize.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Public calendar consensus is about $0.20 EPS and $5.39 billion revenue after Q1 revenue surpassed $5 billion and net income reached $871 million.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: 15-90 day NPLs seasonally improve, ARPAC rises above $16 and Mexico profitability scales without disrupting the efficiency ratio.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Allowances and early delinquencies remain elevated, risk-adjusted NIM stays under pressure or investment spending lifts the full-year efficiency ratio.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Highly liquid and retail-followed; the positive intraday setup and growth narrative increase the risk that a solid result is already anticipated.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Consensus remains broadly constructive on customer monetization, but the market is sensitive to credit-cost and margin revisions rather than headline customer additions.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: International expansion and improving gross margin create a modest upside bias, but sparse analyst coverage and regulatory risk keep the setup low-confidence.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Public calendar estimates show about $0.09 EPS and $175-$177 million revenue, though the EPS figure is inconsistent with recent quarterly run-rate and should be treated cautiously.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: International revenue remains above 70% of mix, gross margin holds above 31% and acquisition synergies sustain operating leverage.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Integration costs, weaker overseas demand, regulation or working-capital use outweigh reported growth.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Options and analyst coverage are thin; institutional put/call data was call-heavy, but evidence quality is insufficient for a strong positioning conclusion.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: No robust sell-side revision set was available, materially lowering confidence.

ranked_companies.timing: 2026-08-14 before market open; 10:00 a.m. ET call
ranked_companies.method_update_note: Small-cap hidden-risk scan; no method change
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Local scale may support volume and pricing, but limited history and acquisition noise leave no dependable immediate-reaction edge.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Calendar consensus is a $0.04 loss per share; the company confirmed a 10:00 a.m. ET Q2 call.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Volume, pricing and acquisition contribution beat a low bar.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Weather, integration costs or weak unit margins overwhelm revenue growth.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: No reliable live options, short-interest or social signal was available.

ranked_companies.timing: 2026-08-14 before market open; 8:30 a.m. ET call
ranked_companies.key_risk_to_call: Very limited public history after listing
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Acquisition-driven scale is interesting, but the new listing lacks enough public reporting history to support a directional earnings edge.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: The company is reporting Q2 before open; its prospectus showed Q1 revenue of about $121.0 million versus $102.5 million a year earlier.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Portfolio-company growth and acquisition economics validate the platform story.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Organic quality, leverage or integration costs disappoint newly formed expectations.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: No dependable live options, short-interest or social evidence was available; post-listing price discovery raises reversal risk.
